bifrost: springboard/ui/src/translation.rs (LanguageAvailability, AvailabilityStatus, TranslationError); springboard/sdk/src/translation.rs (TranslationSession, Translator, TranslationMemory); springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (localization only); springboard/ui/src/format.rs (formatters only); springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (spelling only)
summary: Apple's Translation framework translates text between a language pair on device, through a system translation popover, a session API and language-availability checks. BifrOSt now has the availability model, the error model and a session API that runs over an app-supplied engine, with a phrase-table engine. It still has no language packs, no on-device translation engine, no system popover and no formatted-text translation.

features.note: no SDK popover that translates a selection in place; the triage pointer to springboard/src/shell/browser/ is wrong, those hits are geometric translate() transforms in tiles.rs and values.rs, not text translation

features.apple: TranslationSession (init(installedSource:target:), translate(_:), translate(batch:), translations(from:), cancel(), sourceLanguage, targetLanguage), translationTask(_:action:), translationTask(source:target:action:)
features.note: session over one installed pair with single, batch and cancel; the engine is supplied by the app through the Translator trait. No translationTask equivalent, no prepareTranslation(), no canRequestDownloads, no TranslationSession.Configuration or Strategy, and no on-device engine ships with BifrOSt

features.apple: LanguageAvailability (init(), supportedLanguages, status(from:to:)), LanguageAvailability.Status (installed, supported, unsupported)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/translation.rs (LanguageAvailability, AvailabilityStatus); springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (Locale, Lang: en and is only)
features.note: pair status and installed-pair registry are implemented; the supported language list is supplied by the caller, not built in, because the framework's list is not available offline. status(for:to:) with sample text is missing (needs language identification)

features.apple: TranslationError (nothingToTranslate, unableToIdentifyLanguage, notInstalled, unsupportedSourceLanguage, unsupportedTargetLanguage, unsupportedLanguagePairing, internalError, alreadyCancelled), errorDescription, failureReason
features.note: all eight cases with descriptions; unableToIdentifyLanguage is never produced because there is no language identification

features.apple: TranslationSession.translate(_:) overload that preserves formatting (AttributedString input)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/attributed.rs (attributed text type); no translate step
features.note: the session translates plain strings only; formatting is not carried through a translation

features.feature: Localized UI strings and number and date formats (related, not translation)
features.apple: Not part of Translation; related to Foundation Locale and localized strings
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (Locale, Bundle::load, NumberFormatter, DateFormatter); docs/bifrost-ui.md (Locale and localization section)
features.note: reads <app>/<lang>.lproj/Localizable.strings and formats numbers and dates for en and is; it does not translate text between languages

gaps: No on-device translation engine or language packs: the session runs only over an engine the app supplies (Translator), and the built-in TranslationMemory only returns strings translated ahead of time.
No system translation popover or inline translate action for selected text (translationPresentation).
No translationTask equivalent that runs a session when a view appears or the languages change.
No status(for:to:) check from sample text, so no language identification and no unableToIdentifyLanguage error.
No prepareTranslation(), canRequestDownloads or download request: the framework's download prompt has no BifrOSt counterpart.
No TranslationSession.Configuration or Strategy (preferred model choice).
No formatted-text translation (AttributedString input preserving formatting).
The supported language list is supplied by the caller; BifrOSt has no built-in list of translatable pairs.
Locale data covers only en and is, so even the related localization layer lacks the language pairs a translation feature would need (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Locale gaps).
